description:
Follow-up to bd-veq / gh-94 (non-embedded font substitution, landed a862733).

Substitution now gives real glyphs for a non-embedded font, but NOT correct widths when the PDF omits /Widths entirely — which is legal for the standard 14 (PDF 32000-1:2008 s9.6.2.2). Such a font falls back to /MissingWidth for every glyph, so text renders but lays out wrongly (overlapping or gappy).

hayro solves this with generated AFM metric tables (hayro-interpret src/font/generated/metrics.rs, keyed by glyph name, plus a .notdef default of 250). Porting them is a bulk data port, not logic.

Not urgent: Word and LibreOffice always write /Widths, which is why the maintainer's workbook renders correctly today. The gap bites on hand-written or minimal PDFs that lean on the standard-14 defaults.

Also unported from the same upstream: the ZapfDingbats and Symbol code->name tables (hayro's zapf_dings/symbol modules). Our substitution reaches those faces via the PDF's own /Encoding or the font's built-in encoding, which covers the normal case but not a document relying on the predefined symbolic encodings.
title: kopitiam-pdf: substituted standard-14 fonts have no AFM widths
